records.text: The person who emerged from behind the bush was Jacob Kasparian, and his father was, as I understand it, president of the Los Angeles California Temple.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I was telling you this Bush situation seems to be a little odd. People thought they saw somebody speaking to a bush. And I was able to determine who that person was that kind of comes out of the bush. Again, not saying this person has done anything wrong. ... And then I obviously find out that his dad is the head of—and I hope I'm saying that correctly—president of the Mormon temple in Los Angeles. His name is—this person that was behind the bush—is Jacob Kasparian.

verification.notes: The legacy verification misread this as a claim that Jacob Kasparian was the shooter. Owens explicitly said she was identifying a bystander and was not accusing him of wrongdoing. Her separate claim about the bystander's father is contradicted by the Church's official appointment record: Gary Kezerian Wilde began serving as president of the Los Angeles California Temple in 2024 and held that role during the episode's November 2025 timeframe. No reliable independent source located in the recheck establishes that the person in the video was Jacob Kasparian, so that component remains unsupported; because the compound proposition's temple-presidency component is directly false while the identification cannot be independently resolved, the overall result is false at medium confidence rather than high. The full legacy error and its cited URLs remain in legacy_claim_provenance.

The specific behavior described (not ducking) is not corroborated in any mainstream media coverage of the Charlie Kirk shooting.
